capabilities.description: Clubs book the whole rink or half of it at an agreed hourly rate. Each month they are invoiced for the hours they booked.
capabilities.name: Club rink hire and monthly invoicing

capabilities.description: Managers schedule skating sessions. The number of places for sale shrinks when clubs book part or all of the ice.
capabilities.name: Public skating session scheduling and capacity

capabilities.description: Skaters register as members, and members get an allowance of free entries.
capabilities.name: Membership and free-entry allowance

capabilities.description: Ice temperature readings are tracked. After 10 minutes of warm ice, the next session is put on hold and its skaters are told. The held session is then cancelled with refunds or released for sale again.
capabilities.name: Ice safety monitoring and session disruption handling

capabilities.description: Tickets are priced and reserved when bought. Payment results from the payment provider settle the bookings, and unpaid bookings expire after 15 minutes.
capabilities.name: Ticket sales and payment settlement

capabilities.description: Tracks how many hire skates are in stock and how many are free, counting skates held by pending or paid bookings.
capabilities.name: Skate hire stock management

capabilities.description: When a business rule is broken, the failure is reported as its own kind of error with a clear message.
capabilities.name: Business rule violation reporting
